title: Mochizuki Honami — Brand New Style〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(*Sigh*
I arrived sooner than usual today.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Classes won't start for a little while, so I think I'll use this time to check the Leo/need channel. Some people seem to have commented and...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Good morning, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, Kohane, good morning.
Can I help you with something?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, I don't need any help...
I was just thinking that the Shiba on your phone case is really cute.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, this?
Hehe. It really is adorable.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I had to buy it when I saw it at the store since it reminded me of my real Shiba at home...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, Shibao, right?!
You told me about him once.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
And I really know how you feel.
I can't help but buy keychains and stickers of things that look like my pet.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. I heard that you have an unusual pet.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What kind of animal is your pet? I was thinking a flying squirrel or hedgehog since not many people have those...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, I have a snake.
Her name's Count Pearl.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
A-A snake...?!
I never would've guessed...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And her name's Count Pearl? That has such a classy ring to it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks.
Most people are surprised when they find out that Count Pearl is my pet snake.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But she's really cute.
Every time I come home, she always looks up and flicks her tongue out.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which makes me really happy since it looks like she's saying, “Welcome home.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, Count Pearl must know you very well.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: She does!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, also!
If I stretch my hand out to her, she'll caress her head against it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And her mouth becomes so big whenever she's having a meal... It only takes her one bite!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm always amazed by how she can do that, but she's also a little timid... I think that gap's really cute.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe...
It sounds like you love her very much, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh...
S-Sorry, I didn't mean to go into so much detail.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, I really enjoyed it!
I hardly know anything about snakes. I had no idea they could be so affectionate.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then, can you tell me more about Shibao? What's he like?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shibao has round features and a fluffy body. He loves to sunbathe...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: He seems to like my bed the most for some reason. That's where he usually ends up whenever I leave it out...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I'll take naps with him from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's so cute.
I can see it already.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I have lots of pictures of him. Would you like to see?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, please!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Let's see...
This is what I was just talking about. It's him taking a nap on my bed...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This is him getting excited about dinner. And this is him with a passerby who was nice enough to play with him during one of our walks.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow... These photos are all really adorable... And you've taken so many.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: He's so cute that I sort of can't help taking a lot.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But these pictures all probably look the same to other people.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I can tell that you love Shibao a lot.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, he's a valued member of our family.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: By the way, do you have any pictures of Count Pearl? I'd like to see them if you do.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, I do!
I can show you some later.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But for now, I kind of want to see more photos of Shibao...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case, I'd like to spend some time looking at pictures of Count Pearl later.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, let's both share!
